title: When Reported Earnings Outrun Cash Collections
grain: One issuer, accession and fiscal period in an original or comparative annual filing
dataset: US SEC EDGAR as-filed US-GAAP facts with an Apple audited-note cross-check
question: When earnings outrun collections, do receivables and inventory changes improve next-year cash-flow forecasts?
design: Use a preselected set of 24 nonfinancial issuers. Retain filing dates and accessions, identify first original 10-K observations, and preserve later comparisons and amendments separately. Align annual income and CFO with point-in-time balances. Compare earnings/CFO persistence and a regularized working-capital decomposition using only matured prior labels. Include an issuer-held-out fit, annual falsification and a residual-income valuation sensitivity anchored to book value.
boundary: Predictive associations in a selected panel do not establish manipulation or causality. Vendor non-trade receivables are distinct from customer trade balances. Scenario valuations depend on payout, opening book, abnormal-return persistence and cost of equity.
redistribution: Derived numeric facts from public US filings, with accession IDs. Company-specific annual report remains with its publisher; the source identity is retained.

fields.cfo: Cash provided by operations, USD millions
fields.receivables: Current net customer receivables, USD millions
